inputs.sequence_prompt:
A single continuous fifteen-second live-action shot, beginning at this exact frame and continuing the same airship flight. Camera stays attached to the deck, fixed in the same position and viewing direction. Keep the three actors in the same screen locations: Locke on the LEFT, Celes in the CENTER, and the ONE Setzer on the RIGHT at the existing controls. Exactly three intact bodies. Preserve the exact faces, hair, body proportions, costumes, red wooden masts, ropes, deck, brass rail and lever. No new people, equipment or viewpoint. Setzer keeps his same cream trousers, black coat, blue cuffs and long silver hair. Celes keeps her blonde ponytail and blue ribbon, ivory dress with blue trim and blue boots. Locke keeps his blue headband, open dark jacket, ivory shirt, dark blue trousers, boots and existing equipment.
Maintain the approved image's natural warm beige human skin, ivory cloth, restrained blue and red materials, and muted gray-blue evening sky. Soft steady neutral illumination on skin. No magenta or pink wash on faces, arms or scenery. No increased saturation, exposure pulsing, flashing lamps or new glow. The city stays far below at lower right, moving slowly and coherently down as flight continues. Solid unchanged buildings, no objects flying past, floating boards, new platforms or additional vessels. Keep all ship geometry rigid together.
0-5 seconds: The engine is ALREADY running steadily. Do not start it again. Celes looks away from the horizon toward Locke on her left. She makes a small grounded pivot IN PLACE: her boots rotate naturally on the boards, then her hips and shoulders follow, without stepping toward or crossing the rail. She remains in her central location, arms low and relaxed. Locke notices and turns his head and shoulders slightly toward her, attentive and silent, keeping his feet in his original place. Setzer continues steering ahead, both hands at the same existing controls, no turn toward camera. Wind gently moves their hair and clothes.
5-10 seconds: Celes meets Locke's eyes and speaks softly but clearly in natural Brazilian Portuguese: <d>[Portuguese] Obrigada por confiar em mim.</d> ONLY Celes speaks, with a woman's voice and synchronized mouth movement. Locke listens until she finishes, then gives one warm restrained smile and a small affirmative nod. He remains silent. Celes responds to that nod with a brief relieved smile and releases the tension in her shoulders. No person touches another, no handshake, kiss or embrace. Both stay separate and grounded. Setzer remains forward-facing at the original lever.
10-15 seconds: Celes turns back gradually toward the direction of flight with a natural small pivot, her skirt following her hips with fabric weight. Her feet remain on the deck without sliding. Locke follows her gaze out toward the distant city, then looks ahead. Their expressions settle into quiet determination as the engine continues steadily. Setzer remains at the controls. Keep hair and cloth moving in the mild breeze and the distant city receding slowly. End during ongoing flight and live body reactions, no freeze or fade.
Same continuous three-person composition, no camera movement, cut, zoom, orbit, new deck section or reset of the ascent. No duplicate bodies, extra limbs, cloth merging with legs, feet passing through wood, rail penetration or changed objects. Native audio: steady engine and soft wind throughout, Celes's ONE Portuguese sentence. No male dialogue, extra voices, narration, song or music.
